description: Subscription resource. Ephemeral, in-cache representation (not yet implemented, tracked in #5979) of a single consumer instance bound to a consumer group. The consumer declares one or more `interests[]` (at least one not yet enforced, tracked in #5978) - topic-anchored, typed-filter selections. Per ADR/0005-subscription-filter-typing.md.

consumer_group.description: Full GTS consumer-group identifier. Either named (vendor-namespaced) or anonymous (~{uuid}).

client_agent.description: RFC 9110 User-Agent grammar; ASCII; 1-256 bytes. Informational diagnostic hint surfaced in operational logs (NEVER as a metric label). Required at create per ADR-0004.

interests.description: Array of topic-anchored typed-filter selections. >=1 entry (not yet enforced, tracked in #5978); <=64 entries (compile-time const JoinRequest::MAX_INTERESTS). Different members of the same consumer group MAY declare different `interests[]` sets (rolling-deploy preserved by construction). Per ADR/0005-subscription-filter-typing.md.

session_timeout.description: ISO 8601 duration; after the member's stream closes, the subscription is reaped unless a stream reopens within this window. Defaults to PT30S; any positive duration is accepted.

assigned.description: Subset of the group's (topic, partition) pairs assigned to this subscription by the rebalance algorithm. Computed at JOIN and updated on every topology change. Topic-centric, keyed by (topic, partition) as SEEK positions are.

topology_version.description: Group topology version at the time this subscription's assignment was computed. Consumers detect topology changes from the topology_version carried in topology frames, or from a stream that ends with rebalanced (a gained partition) or lose_all (every partition lost).

created_at.description: Wall-clock instant this subscription was created (at JOIN). The stable sort key for listing subscriptions (newest first).

Interest.description: A single topic-anchored typed-filter selection. Per ADR/0005-subscription-filter-typing.md.

topic.description: Full GTS topic identifier. Partition / rebalance / authz unit (Kafka-style). Required.

subject_tenant.description: The tenant the interest reads; under tenant_subtree_included the root of the subtree read. Optional: when absent the broker uses the caller's tenant, and the response echoes the resolved value. The nil UUID is refused. Under only_mine, a tenant other than the caller's is refused.

ownership_filter.description: Which events of the tenant the interest reads. only_mine (default): events of the caller's own tenant whose subject_owner is the caller; an unowned event never matches. entire_tenant: every event of subject_tenant. tenant_subtree_included: every event of subject_tenant and the tenants below it, bounded by barrier_mode and the consume scope.

barrier_mode.description: How to handle self-managed tenant boundaries. respect (default) stops at self_managed=true tenants. ignore reads through them. No effect under only_mine.

types.description: GTS event-type patterns. >=1 entry (not yet enforced, tracked in #5978); <=32 entries (compile-time const JoinRequest::MAX_TYPES_PER_INTEREST). Wildcards per GTS spec §10 (single trailing `*` at a segment boundary). Patterns scoped to the declared `topic` - types belonging to other topics are never matched. Per-name-latest + minor-version-omitted matching applied at JOIN.

subject_types.description: Optional consumer-side selector: delivers only events whose subject_type matches one of these GTS type patterns. No authorization meaning; it never widens the caller's access. 1-32 entries.

filter.description: Optional per-interest filter. When present, both engine and expression are required. The broker validates engine resolves to a registered filter engine and compiles expression at JOIN time (not yet implemented, tracked in #5978).

engine.description: Full GTS identifier of the filter engine (e.g. gts.cf.core.events.filter.v1~cf.core.expression.cel.v1).

expression.description: Engine-specific source string. 1–4096 bytes. For CEL, a CEL-syntax string.
